en.question: Without stains or fluorescent dyes, what can light show us in tissue?
en.method: A femtosecond near-infrared laser is focused into tissue. Collagen answers with second-harmonic generation (SHG) and molecules inside cells answer with two-photon fluorescence. Both signals come from the tissue itself, which is why the method is called label-free. The lab's microscope also integrates fluorescence-lifetime imaging and CARS (coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering), which reads molecular vibrations.
en.finding: A 2021 paper describes the multimodal microscope. A 2025 esophageal study images collagen with SHG and cells with two-photon fluorescence, side by side with H&E-stained sections. A 2026 oral-cancer study analyzes clinical data from 263 patients and finds collagen fibers aligned perpendicular to the tumor boundary in samples with the worst pattern of invasion (WPOI-5).
en.status: All of these images come from excised tissue sections. Whether the same contrast can be obtained in living tissue, during surgery, is not yet known.
en.caption: Fig. 2 of the 2025 esophageal study: H&E-stained sections alongside SHG, two-photon fluorescence and merged images. Full figure retained.
en.home_question: Without stains, what can light show?
en.home_method: SHG for collagen, two-photon fluorescence for cells; both signals come from the tissue itself.
en.home_finding: A 2025 esophageal study sets these optical images side by side with H&E-stained sections.

zh.question: 不染色、不加螢光劑，光能讓我們在組織裡看見什麼？
zh.method: 把飛秒近紅外雷射聚焦在組織上，膠原蛋白會發出二倍頻光（SHG），細胞裡的分子會發出雙光子螢光。兩種訊號都來自組織本身，所以稱為無標記成像。實驗室的顯微平台另外整合了螢光生命期，以及讀取分子振動的 CARS（相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射）。
zh.finding: 2021 年的論文描述這套多模態顯微平台。2025 年的食道研究用 SHG 拍膠原、用雙光子螢光拍細胞，並和 H&E 染色切片並排對照。2026 年的口腔癌研究分析 263 位病人的臨床資料，並在帶有最差侵犯型態（WPOI-5）的樣本裡，看到膠原纖維傾向垂直於腫瘤邊界。
zh.status: 這些影像都來自取下來的組織切片。同樣的對比能不能在活體、在手術當下取得，還沒有答案。
zh.caption: 2025 年食道研究圖 2：H&E 染色切片，以及 SHG、雙光子螢光與合併影像，保留完整圖。
zh.home_method: SHG 拍膠原，雙光子螢光拍細胞；訊號都來自組織本身。
zh.home_finding: 2025 年食道研究把這兩種光學影像和 H&E 染色切片並排對照。

en.question: When tissue becomes diseased, how much does the arrangement of collagen change?
en.method: The polarization of the incoming light is rotated step by step while the SHG signal is recorded; this is polarization-resolved SHG (P-SHG). The shape of the response yields three quantities: the susceptibility ratio χ33/χ31, the degree of linear polarization, and the distribution of fiber orientations.
en.finding: A 2024 cartilage study compares normal, osteoarthritic and rheumatoid-arthritis tissue. Normal cartilage has χ33/χ31 values distinct from both diseased groups; osteoarthritic cartilage shows a higher degree of linear polarization and more directional fibers; rheumatoid-arthritis cartilage shows a more heterogeneous molecular orientation. A 2026 oral-cancer study applies the same measurement and finds increased collagen cross-linking and remodeling in the more invasive samples.
en.status: Whether these three quantities can serve as diagnostic markers is still open: the paper presents them as a reference, and more samples are needed. A 2026 review surveys the same kind of measurement in other diseases.
en.caption: Fig. 3 of the 2024 cartilage study: H&E sections, SHG intensity and polarization-derived maps of osteoarthritic cartilage. Full figure retained.
en.home_question: How much does collagen change when tissue is diseased?
en.home_method: Rotate the polarization of the light and read fiber arrangement from how the SHG signal responds.
en.home_finding: A 2024 study: fibers are more directional in osteoarthritic cartilage and more disordered in rheumatoid arthritis.

zh.question: 組織生病之後，膠原蛋白的排列變了多少？
zh.method: 把入射光的偏振方向一步一步轉過去，記錄 SHG 訊號怎麼跟著變，這叫偏振解析 SHG（P-SHG）。從變化的形狀可以算出三個量：感受率比值 χ33/χ31、線偏振度，以及纖維方向的分布。
zh.finding: 2024 年的軟骨研究比較正常、退化性關節炎與類風濕性關節炎三種組織。正常軟骨的 χ33/χ31 與兩種病變組織不同；退化性關節炎的線偏振度較高，纖維排列更有方向性；類風濕性關節炎的分子排列則較雜亂。2026 年的口腔癌研究也用同一套量測，在侵犯性較強的樣本裡看到膠原交聯與重塑增加。
zh.status: 這三個量能不能當成診斷指標，論文只把它們定位為參考，還需要更多樣本驗證。2026 年的回顧論文整理了同類量測在其他疾病上的應用。
zh.caption: 2024 年軟骨研究圖 3：退化性關節炎軟骨的 H&E 切片、SHG 強度與偏振參數圖，保留完整圖。
zh.home_question: 組織生病，膠原蛋白的排列變了多少？
zh.home_method: 轉動入射光的偏振，從 SHG 訊號的變化算出纖維怎麼排。
zh.home_finding: 2024 年研究：退化性關節炎的軟骨纖維排列更有方向性，類風濕性關節炎則較雜亂。

en.question: A microscope cannot go inside the body. Can the light go in by itself?
en.method: The excitation light is sent through an optical fiber to a miniature probe, and the signal returns along the same path. The difficulty is that femtosecond pulses stretch inside a fiber, so they have to be pre-compensated before they enter it.
en.finding: A 2021 paper describes a compact multimodal microscope that incorporates a photonic crystal fiber; it is the starting point for this direction. The miniature probe itself has no published results yet.
en.status: How small the probe can be made, and how much image quality survives, are not yet backed by data we can publish. This is the lab's long-term direction.
en.caption: Concept illustration: an optical fiber delivers excitation light to a handheld probe. Rendered from the research map's 3D scene; not a photograph of a lab instrument.
en.home_question: Where a microscope cannot go, can light?
en.home_method: An optical fiber carries the excitation light to a miniature probe and brings the signal back.
en.home_finding: A 2021 multimodal microscope is the starting point; the probe itself has no published results yet.

zh.question: 顯微鏡搬不進體內，光能不能自己進去？
zh.method: 把激發光送進光纖、接到微型探頭，再沿原路把訊號收回來。難處在於飛秒脈衝經過光纖會被拉寬，進光纖之前得先補償。
zh.finding: 2021 年的論文描述一套整合光子晶體光纖的精簡型多模態顯微平台，是這個方向的起點。微型探頭本身還沒有發表成果。
zh.status: 探頭能做到多小、影像品質能保留多少，目前沒有可以公開的數據。這是實驗室的長期方向。
zh.caption: 概念示意：光纖把激發光送到手持探頭。這是研究地圖 3D 場景的渲染圖，不是實驗室的實機照片。
zh.home_question: 顯微鏡進不去的地方，光進得去嗎？
zh.home_method: 用光纖把激發光送到微型探頭，再把訊號收回來。
zh.home_finding: 2021 年的多模態顯微平台是起點；探頭本身還沒有發表成果。

en.question: Can a computer separate tissues that are hard to tell apart by eye?
en.method: Two routes run side by side. One computes texture features from the image (the gray-level co-occurrence matrix, GLCM) and passes them to a conventional classifier; the other lets a deep-learning model look at the image directly.
en.finding: A 2026 prostate study compares the two routes on 295 two-photon fluorescence images: the texture-feature classifier reaches 71.9% accuracy and the best deep-learning model 86.1% (AUC about 0.91), evaluated so that images from one sample group never appear in both training and testing. A 2025 esophageal study pairs SHG texture features with a support-vector machine and reports accuracies between 75% and 95.65% across four comparisons. A 2026 pilot study addresses oral-lesion classification.
en.status: All of these numbers come from cross-validation within a single dataset. Whether they hold at another hospital, with other patients, has to be answered with larger independent cohorts; the prostate paper says so itself.
en.caption: Fig. 8 of the 2025 esophageal study: ROC curves of an SVM classifier trained on SHG image texture features, for four pairwise comparisons. Full figure retained.
en.home_question: Can a computer separate tissues the eye cannot?
en.home_method: One route computes texture features; the other lets deep learning read the image directly.
en.home_finding: A 2026 prostate study: 86.1% accuracy with deep learning, 71.9% with texture features (cross-validation).

zh.question: 肉眼難以區分的組織，電腦能從影像裡分出來嗎？
zh.method: 兩條路並行。一條先算出影像的紋理特徵（灰階共現矩陣，GLCM），再交給傳統分類器；另一條讓深度學習模型直接看影像。
zh.finding: 2026 年的攝護腺研究用 295 張雙光子螢光影像比較這兩條路：紋理特徵分類器的準確率是 71.9%，最佳的深度學習模型是 86.1%（AUC 約 0.91）；評估時，同一組樣本不會同時出現在訓練與測試裡。2025 年的食道研究以 SHG 影像的紋理特徵加上支持向量機，四組比較的準確率在 75% 到 95.65% 之間。2026 年另有一篇口腔病灶分類的前導研究。
zh.status: 這些數字都是在單一資料集裡交叉驗證得到的。換一家醫院、換一批病人還準不準，要靠更大的獨立世代來回答；攝護腺論文自己也這麼寫。
zh.caption: 2025 年食道研究圖 8：以 SHG 影像紋理特徵訓練的 SVM 分類器，在四組兩兩比較下的 ROC 曲線，保留完整圖。
zh.home_question: 肉眼難分的組織，電腦分得出來嗎？
zh.home_method: 一條路算紋理特徵，一條路讓深度學習直接看影像。
zh.home_finding: 2026 年攝護腺研究：深度學習準確率 86.1%，紋理特徵 71.9%（交叉驗證）。
